events.title: Being Heumann
events.description: OPENS NOVEMBER 13 | Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

events.title: La Bola Negra
events.description: OPENS NOVEMBER 6 | Across three distinct eras, the intertwined lives of three men remain bound by a shared thread of desire, sexuality, enduring pain and the lasting weight of their complex legacies.

events.title: You Can See Everything
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 16 | "Why would I deceive you?" Notorious Silicon Valley felon Elizabeth Holmes invites a film crew into her home in the final days before she heads to prison. Directed by Nathan Fielder & Lance Oppenheim.

events.title: Fjord
events.description: OPENS NOVEMBER 13 | From two⁠-⁠time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close⁠-⁠knit, coastal town. Starring Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve.

events.title: Happy Hour Cans
events.description: South Ave patio cans before the weekend crush.

events.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 30 | When a theft goes awry, a veteran pickpocket is sent on a mission through New York to reclaim it.

events.title: Wild Horse Nine
events.description: OPENS NOVEMBER 6 | Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Spy shenanigans ensue. Written and directed by Martin McDonagh (In Bruges, The Banshees of Inisherin).
